# Preamble

```{r}
# Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(brms)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
# Relative working directory
active_wd <- function(x, output = FALSE) {
    rdir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
    rdir <- sub("[^/]*$", "", rdir)
    rdir <- paste0(rdir, x)
    setwd(rdir)
    if (output == TRUE) {
        return(getwd())
    }
}
active_wd("data")
# Load in data
datac <- read_csv("combined_data.csv")
datac <- datac[datac$type == "Heterogenous",]
reversals <- 4
```

# Data prep

```{r}
# Data prep for analysis

# Select final 4 reversals in each staircase for each Participant
last_revs <- data.frame()
for (i in unique(datac$Participant)) {
    for (j in unique(datac$start_id)) {
        for (k in unique(datac$type)) {
            for (l in unique(datac$envelope_1)) {
                for (m in unique(datac$repetition)) {
                    for (n in unique(datac$direction)) {
                        rev <- subset(datac, Participant == i & type == k & envelope_1 == l & repetition == m & direction == n & l_reversal == 1)
                        if (!j %in% rev$start_id) next
                        rev <- subset(rev, start_id == j)
                        num <- length(rev$l_reversal) - reversals
                        rev <- rev[-c(1:num), ]
                        last_revs <- rbind(last_revs, rev)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Categorise each reversal
k <- 1
for (i in 1:nrow(last_revs)) {
    if (k > reversals) k <- 1
    last_revs$trial_num[i] <- k
    k <- k + 1
}

# Group and condense response/reversal data
revs <- last_revs %>%
    group_by(Participant, start_id, direction, envelope_1, type, repetition, trial_num) %>%
    summarise("Level" = mean(second - first)) %>%
    mutate("trial_num" = as.integer(trial_num), "start_id" = factor(start_id)) %>%
    arrange(Participant, start_id, direction, envelope_1, type, repetition, trial_num)

# Calculate PSE for each standard and envelope for each participant (and Z scores)
pse <- revs %>%
    group_by(Participant, start_id, envelope_1, type, repetition) %>%
    summarise("PSE" = mean(Level))

pse$PSEtotal <- 0
pse$standard <- 0
for (i in 1:length(unique(pse$envelope_1))) {
    for (j in 1:length(unique(pse$start_id))) {
        e <- unique(pse$envelope_1)[i]
        if (!j %in% unique(pse$start_id[pse$envelope_1 == e])) next
        pse$PSEtotal[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j] <- datac$first[datac$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & datac$start_id == j] + pse$PSE[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j]
        pse$standard[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j] <- datac$first[datac$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & datac$start_id == j]
    }
}

envelopes_b <- data.frame("Participant" = pse$Participant, "start_id" = pse$start_id, "envelope_1" = pse$envelope_1, "type" = pse$type, "repetition" = pse$repetition, "Flat" = 0, "Percussive" = 0)

for (i in 1:length(pse$Participant)) {
    envelopes_b$Flat[i] <- ifelse(pse$envelope_1[i] == "flat", pse$standard[i], pse$PSEtotal[i])
}
for (i in 1:length(pse$Participant)) {
    envelopes_b$Percussive[i] <- ifelse(pse$envelope_1[i] == "perc", pse$standard[i], pse$PSEtotal[i])
}
envelopes_b$delta <- envelopes_b$Percussive - envelopes_b$Flat
envelopes_b$Participant <- factor(envelopes_b$Participant)
envelopes_b$start_id <- factor(envelopes_b$start_id)
envelopes_b$envelope_1 <- factor(envelopes_b$envelope_1)
```

# Model selection

```{r}
# Random effects

priors <- c(
    prior(cauchy(0,2), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"),
    prior(cauchy(1,1), class = "b", coef = "Flat"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "envelope_1perc"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "Flat:envelope_1perc")
)

model <- brm(
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat * envelope_1 + (1 + Flat|Participant),
    data = envelopes_b,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors,
    iter = 20000,
    warmup = 10000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
)

model2 <- brm( # THE BEST
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat * envelope_1 + (1|Participant),
    data = envelopes_b,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors,
    iter = 20000,
    warmup = 10000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)
bf31 <- log(bayes_factor(model2, model)$bf, 10)
model3 <- model2

model2 <- brm(
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat * envelope_1 + (0 + Flat|Participant),
    data = envelopes_b,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors,
    iter = 20000,
    warmup = 10000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
)
bf32 <- log(bayes_factor(model2, model)$bf, 10)

model2 <- brm(
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat * envelope_1,
    data = envelopes_b,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors,
    iter = 20000,
    warmup = 10000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)
bf33 <- log(bayes_factor(model2, model)$bf, 10)
model <- model3
```

# Final model

```{r}
# FINAL MODEL 3
priors6 <- c(
    prior(cauchy(0,2), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"),
    prior(constant(1), class = "b", coef = "Flat"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "envelope_1perc")
)

final_model3 <- brm(
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat + envelope_1 + (1|Participant),
    data = envelopes_b,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors6,
    iter = 20000,
    warmup = 10000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)
```

# Model comparison figure (Combined)

```{r}
# Bayes factors for RE comparisons
bf3adf <- data.frame(
    model = factor(c(2, 3, 4)),
    bflog = c(bf31, bf32, bf33),
    select = factor(c(1,0,0)),
    stage = "(bold(I))~Random~Effects"
)
# Bayes factors for FE comparisons
bf3bdf <- data.frame(
    model = factor(c(2, 3, 4)),
    bflog = c(bf34, bf35, bf36),
    select = factor(c(1,0,0)),
    stage = "(bold(II))~Fixed~Effects"
)
# Bayes factors for IS comparisons
bf3cdf <- data.frame(
    model = factor(c(2, 3, 4)),
    bflog = c(bf37, bf38, bf39),
    select = factor(c(0,1,0)),
    stage = "(bold(III))~Intercept/Slope"
)
# All together BF
bfall3 <- rbind(bf3adf, bf3bdf, bf3cdf)

fig3pan1 <- bfall3 |>  
    ggplot(aes(bflog, factor(model, level = sort(levels(model), decreasing = T)), color = select)) +
    theme_classic() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-6,6)) +
    scale_color_manual("Selected", values = c("#ab2727", "#4f852c"), labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = factor(model, level = sort(levels(model), decreasing = T)))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
    geom_point(pch = 16, size = 3) +
    labs(x = expression(log[10](italic(BF))), y = expression(Model), title = expression((bold(A))~Combined~Model~Comparisons)) +
    facet_wrap(~stage, ncol = 1, nrow = 3, labeller = label_parsed) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig3pan1
# ggsave("bfall3.svg", width = 5, height = 5)
```

# Model 3 regression figure

```{r}
draws3 <- as_draws_df(final_model3)[,1:3]
set.seed(1)
draws3 <- draws3[sample(1:100000, 1000, replace = TRUE),]
lines3 <- data.frame(
    int = c(draws3$b_Intercept, draws3$b_Intercept + draws3$b_envelope_1perc),
    slope = c(draws3$b_Flat, draws3$b_Flat),
    env = rep(c("flat","perc"), each = nrow(draws3))
)
main3 <- summary(final_model3)$fixed[,1]
maindf <- data.frame(
    int = c(main3[1], main3[1] + main3[3]),
    slope = c(main3[2], main3[2]),
    env = c("flat", "perc")
)

fig3pan2 <- ggplot() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), lim = c(-60, -20)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), lim = c(-60, -20)) +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_abline(data = maindf, aes(intercept = int, slope = slope, color = env)) +
    geom_abline(data = lines3, aes(intercept = int, slope = slope, color = env), alpha = 0.01) +
    scale_color_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c("darkgreen", "#5400ff")) +
    labs(x = "Flat (dB)", y = "Percussive (dB)", title = expression((bold(B))~"Model including Standard envelope")) +
    annotate("text", x = -35, y = -57.5, label = "R^2 == 0.98", parse = TRUE, size = 4, hjust = "left") +
    annotate("label", x = -35, y = -52.5, label = "italic(y) == italic(x) - 0.98", parse = TRUE, size = 4, hjust = "left", fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.5) +
    annotate("label", x = -35, y = -55, label = "italic(y) == italic(x) - 0.4", parse = TRUE, size = 4, hjust = "left", fill = "#5400ff", alpha = 0.5) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig3pan2
# ggsave("reg1.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```

# Model 4 regression figure

```{r}
draws4 <- as_draws_df(final_model4)[,1]
set.seed(1)
draws4 <- draws4[sample(1:100000, 1000, replace = TRUE),]
lines4 <- data.frame(
    int = draws4$b_Intercept
)
main4 <- summary(final_model4)$fixed[1,1]

fig3pan3 <- ggplot() +
    # lims(x = c(-80, 0), y = c(-80, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0.5), lim = c(-60, -20)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0.5), lim = c(-60, -20)) +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_abline(intercept = main4, slope = 1) +
    geom_abline(data = lines4, aes(intercept = int, slope = 1), alpha = 0.01) +
    labs(x = "Flat (dB)", y = "Percussive (dB)", title = expression((bold(C))~"Model excluding Standard envelope")) +
    annotate("text", x = -35, y = -58, label = "italic(R^2) == 0.98", parse = TRUE, size = 4, hjust = "left") +
    annotate("text", x = -35, y = -55, label = "italic(y == x - 0.7)", parse = TRUE, size = 4, hjust = "left")
fig3pan3
# ggsave("reg2.pdf", width = 5, height = 5)
```
